title: Title & Registration Services Service Type Assignment and State Fee Schedule
content:
## 1. Service type

The Title & Registration Services service type follows the purchase:

| Service type | Applies when |
|---|---|
| Kestrel Title-Only Service | the buyer elects to register the vehicle personally; Kestrel transfers the title only (any registration state) |
| Kestrel In-State Plate Transfer | the registration state equals the selling dealer state and the buyer has a transferable plate in the buyer's own name |
| Kestrel In-State New Registration | the registration state equals the selling dealer state and the buyer has no transferable plate in the buyer's own name |
| Kestrel Specialty Plate Registration | a specialty or personalized plate is requested in the dealer state (registration state equals the selling dealer state) |
| Kestrel Out-of-State Registration | the registration state differs from the selling dealer state and does not require a VIN inspection or emissions certificate for a vehicle last titled elsewhere |
| Kestrel Out-of-State Registration with Inspection | the registration state differs from the selling dealer state and requires a VIN inspection or emissions certificate for a vehicle last titled elsewhere |

## 2. Collection at opening

At opening, the state fees in the service type's fee components are collected from the registration state's fee schedule, each as its own entry, plus the lien recording fee when a lienholder is to be recorded. A state fee is collected only on an order whose status is awaiting documents or rejected, as the order's status shows in the system before the fee is booked. The temp tag fee collected at opening covers the original tag only; extension tag fees are not collected from the customer when the service type's extension tag fee switch is No.

The following clause is **no longer in force** and has been superseded by the current basis for fee-shortage returns: "after a fee-shortage rejection the stated shortage is collected as its own entry within the fee shortage collection days."

## 3. State fee schedule (USD)

| State | Title fee | Registration fee | New plate fee | Plate transfer fee | Specialty plate fee | Lien recording fee | Temp tag fee |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| AZ | 4.00 | 8.00 | 5.00 | 12.00 | 25.00 | 0.00 | 15.00 |
| TX | 33.00 | 51.75 | 0.00 | 0.00 | 40.00 | 0.00 | 5.00 |
| GA | 18.00 | 20.00 | 0.00 | 0.00 | 35.00 | 0.00 | 0.00 |
| FL | 77.75 | 46.15 | 225.00 | 4.60 | 25.00 | 2.00 | 2.00 |
| NC | 56.00 | 38.75 | 0.00 | 24.00 | 30.00 | 21.50 | 0.00 |
| OH | 15.00 | 34.50 | 0.00 | 5.00 | 35.00 | 15.00 | 0.00 |
| PA | 67.00 | 45.00 | 0.00 | 11.00 | 20.00 | 34.00 | 0.00 |
| CO | 7.20 | 50.00 | 0.00 | 0.00 | 25.00 | 0.00 | 0.00 |

Which fees a service type collects is its fee component list; the amount of each comes from the row of the registration state.

## 4. Worked example (hypothetical order)

A Kestrel In-State New Registration order registering in FL, with a lienholder to be recorded, collects at opening five separate entries: title fee 77.75, registration fee 46.15, new plate fee 225.00, temp tag fee 2.00 and lien recording fee 2.00, together 352.90. Without a lienholder the lien recording fee entry is not collected and the four entries come to 350.90.

## 5. Status test

| Order status | State fee may be collected |
|---|---|
| awaiting documents | yes |
| rejected | yes |
| ready to submit, submitted, registered, completed, cancelled | no |

superseded_clauses: after a fee-shortage rejection the stated shortage is collected as its own entry within the fee shortage collection days.
